privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft. The final text will be published after legal review.
privacy.collectText: Your Telegram ID, the nickname you choose, your language and your activity in the app (points, completed tasks).
privacy.notCollectText: We don't ask for your real name, phone number, address or photos. Your Telegram name and photo are not stored.
privacy.whyText: To count your points, show the rating and, if you allow it, send reminders.
privacy.whoText: Only your nickname is shown in the rating. Your data is not used for advertising and is never sold.
privacy.deleteText: You can delete your data at any time: Profile → "Delete my data".
privacy.contactText: If you have questions, message the Ekoustoz bot.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.draft: Draft. The final text will be published after legal review.
terms.aboutText: Ekoustoz is a free educational app that teaches how to sort waste and make useful things from it. There are no ads or payments in the app.
terms.whoText: The app is for schoolchildren, teachers and parents. If you're a student, use it with your parents' or teacher's knowledge.
terms.safetyText: Follow the safety marks on projects: 🟡 work only with an adult watching, and 🔴 work is done by adults only. Be careful with sharp, hot and electrical things.
terms.nicknameText: Your nickname must not contain a real name, a phone number or rude words. If the rules are broken, the team may hide the nickname, ask for a new one or block the account.
terms.pointsText: Points are for the game and have no money value. Play fair: points gained by cheating will be cancelled.
terms.contentText: The videos, texts and pictures in the app belong to the Ekoustoz team. You may use them in lessons for educational purposes.
terms.changesText: If these terms change, we'll let you know in the app or through the bot.
terms.contactText: If you have questions, message the Ekoustoz bot.
